mods.description: Useful Minecraft command tools in a Fabric mod and VSCode Extension (syntax highlighting, completion, debugging, etc.)

releases.notes:
Changes:
- Added support for color pickers in VSCode
- (block-)entity NBT can now be read in everywhere (selectors, `data merge`, etc.)
- Added support for auto-completing NBT paths
- All of the mod's NBT auto-completions are also available in chat now (if this conflicts with other mods, it can be disabled in the config by setting `add-ingame-suggestions` to `false`)
- Selectors, NBT paths, Commands and Macros inside NBT or JSON strings are also parsed now
- The macro cache now detects if only a single macro was changed, in which case only that macro has to be reparsed
- Added warnings for unknown/unused JSON or NBT keys
- Added `@` as trigger character for completions
- Added "SavedFileAutomaticReloadDelay" setting in VSCode
- Added the `/commandcrafter:datagen` clientside command, which uses Minecraft's datagen to produce files similar to mcmeta (`commands.json`,`blocks.json` and `registries.json`), which can be loaded into Spyglass. The corresponding Spyglass config is also generated in the output folder if there isn't already a Spyglass config present.
    - The data generation can also be invoked on server start by setting the `-Dcc_server_datagen_dir=path/to/output` JVM argument
- "Go to definition" now also works if the cursor is exactly at the end of an id
- Some performance improvements

Removed:
- Removed SNBT highlighting for strings that just look like SNBT but Minecraft doesn't actually parse them as SNBT

Fixes:
- Fixed SNBT builtin functions not being highlighted
- Fixed SNBT incorrectly suggesting commas in some places
- Fixed missing suggestions for tag entries
- Fixed that the mod suggested some unicode name in `"\N{...}"` that aren't actually accepted by Minecraft
- Fixed particle argument analyzer in `vanilla easyNewLine` trying to read nbt in lines following it
- Fixed that `max_format` suggestions in `pack.mcmeta` specified a minor version, which isn't forwards compatible
- Fixed some thread pools not being shutdown when Minecraft exits and leading to a watchdog timeout

This mod requires [fabric-language-kotlin](https://github.com/FabricMC/fabric-language-kotlin) to be installed.

releases.notes:
Updated to 26.1-26.1.2

Changes:
- Auto completing a JSON or SNBT key no longer inserts a space after the colon. This is because typing the space manually allows VSCode to also load auto-completions for the value

Removed:
- Removed warning for missing `block_pos` tag when summoning a `BlockAttachedEntity`, since it doesn't prevent the entity from spawning    

Fixes:
- Fixed completely missing nbt completions for `{equipment:{|}}` in `summon`
- Fixed that it was impossible to build datapacks for multiple versions with `datapack build`. Overlay directories will be included in the built datapack now (as well as all other files in the datapack folder such as `.vscode`) and it is now possible to skip function validation at specific locations using `@language vanilla noBuildCheck`
- Fixed `pack.mcmeta` analyzer not reading `"filter"` section
- Fixed that multiline arguments at the end of a `@language vanilly easyNewLine` command were missing suggestions in the following lines if the argument had an error
- Fixed completely missing analyzing of `pack.mcmeta` specifically on Windows (eww)

This mod requires [fabric-language-kotlin](https://github.com/FabricMC/fabric-language-kotlin) to be installed.

mods.description: The CommandCrafter Minecraft mod aims to provide useful tools for command development

releases.notes:
Works with 1.21.6, 1.21.7 and 1.21.8

- Updated to fabric loader 0.17.x

Changes:
- Improved autocomplete in multiline commands
- Boolean value suggestions in SNBT will now be `true`/`false` instead of `1b`/`0b`
- "Load namespace:" entries in storage viewer are at the top now
- Improved file search of debugger
- Added suggestions for keybind text component
- Show proper error message when VSCode tries to evaluate something (evaluation is not supported yet)

Fixes:
- Fixed errors when vanilla (multiline) commands had trailing spaces on a line
- Fixed problems with the debugger in macro functions
- Fixed duplicated breakpoints on reload
- Fixed "Step In" skipping commands when paused on a command result
- Fixed command feedback from commands like `/function` appearing too early in VSCode
- Fixed error handling of `/function` commands in the debugger
- Fixed debugger in inline tags using incorrect positions
- Fixed that SNBT strings missing their second quotation had no autocomplete
- Fixed completely missing autocomplete and errors with some inline loot tables, predicates, item modifiers or dialogs 
- Fixed predicates and item modifiers not being able to reload automatically
- Fixed errors with some command arguments when `easyNewLine` was enabled and they tried to read the next lines, which were later parsed a second time, leading to conflicts

This mod requires [fabric-language-kotlin](https://github.com/FabricMC/fabric-language-kotlin) to be installed.

releases.notes:
Only works with Fabric Loader 0.16.14 and below!

- Updated to 1.21.6 (also works on 1.21.7 and 1.21.8)
- CommandCrafter now only connects to a dedicated server if the mod versions match
- Added "Load namespace:" entries to storage viewer when storages in a namspace exist but haven't been loaded by the game yet
- NBT suggestions for entity data in `/summon` and for block data
- Added support for dialogs

Bugfixes:
- Player was kicked from server when opening storages with too much data
- Selector filters after `type=` weren't being analyzed
- `/reload` kicked players without CommandCrafter on a dedicated server with CommandCrafter
- Diagnostics were not removed by the language server after a file was deleted
- The language server was missing datapack features when in the main menu

Side note: I am planning to release snapshot versions of the mod if I have the time to give you quicker access to new datapack features (like dialogs)

releases.notes:
Only works with Fabric Loader 0.16.14 and below!

Important bugfix: Debugging macro functions works now

Changes:
- New Minecraft Console
- Added VSCode commands to reload files: `Reload Datapack`, `Reload Resourcepack` and `Reload Shaders`
    - Reloads can also be configured to happen automatically when saving a file in VSCode by enabling the following keys in the feature config: `autoreload.datapack_json`, `autoreload.resourcepack` and `autoreload.datapack_functions`
- When SNBT is written in a string, tags and values are still highlighted, but the string color will be kept for characters that aren't highlighted to make it clear that the value is a string

And other bugfixes

This mod requires [fabric-language-kotlin](https://github.com/FabricMC/fabric-language-kotlin) to be installed.
